title: Elysia signed download links
context: Staff mint signed links of the form /dl/:name?exp=<unix seconds>&sig=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "name:exp">. Links are rejected after exp. Files are served only from /data/exports, even for staff-supplied names. Downloads must not be stored by shared caches (Cache-Control private, no-store).
